kits.name: Northern kauri forest
kits.note: Kauri on ridges, taraire and tawa in gullies.

kits.name: Northern podocarp-broadleaf forest
kits.note: The general northern bush.
kits.examples: Puketī and Ōmahuta, Waitākere Ranges, Hūnua

kits.name: Central podocarp-broadleaf forest
kits.note: No kauri, taraire or pōhutukawa. Rimu emergents over tawa.

kits.name: Kahikatea swamp forest
kits.note: Dense pure stands, wet ground. A major 1810 landscape that's gone today.
kits.examples: Hauraki and Waikato remnants (Kaihere, Yarndley's Bush), Kaipara

kits.name: Montane beech forest
kits.note: Snow sets in winter.

kits.name: West Coast rimu-rātā forest
kits.note: Rātā flowering turns the hills red in summer.

kits.name: Northern coastal forest
kits.note: Pōhutukawa line the cliffs and lean over the water.
kits.examples: Bay of Islands, Coromandel, Whangārei Heads

kits.name: Southern coastal forest
kits.note: Wind-shorn canopy.

kits.name: Forest-scrub mosaic
kits.note: Now a cleared look, not a map kit: cleared forest cells use this mix. Kauri ricker only in the north.

kits.name: Mānuka-kānuka scrub
kits.note: Now a cleared look, not a map kit: cleared forest cells use this mix. White haze when flowering, Nov–Jan.

kits.name: Bracken fernland
kits.note: Now a cleared look, not a map kit: cleared forest cells use this mix. The look of most open country in 1810. Burn scars belong to the next post.
kits.examples: Northland and Hokianga hills, Te Paki

kits.name: Plateau tussock and pumice
kits.note: Gold in summer, frost and snow in winter.

kits.name: South Island tussock plains
kits.note: Nor'west browning Jan–Mar; tī kōuka for umu tī.

kits.name: Ironsand dunes
kits.note: Use ironsand material from Waikato to Taranaki.
kits.examples: Manawatū dunefield, Kaipara heads, Karioi and Kariotahi

kits.name: Northern estuary
kits.note: Kuaka flocks Sep–Mar.
kits.examples: Kaipara, Kerikeri and Waitangi inlets, Pūkorokoro Miranda

kits.name: Southern estuary and saltmarsh
kits.note: No mangroves.

kits.name: Subalpine and alpine
kits.note: Snowline layer drives the season.

kits.name: Geothermal field
kits.note: Steam stronger on cold mornings.
kits.examples: Waiotapu, Whakarewarewa, Ōrākei Kōrako, Craters of the Moon

kits.name: Riverbed and lake edge
kits.note: Kōwhai gold along rivers in spring.
kits.examples: Waikato River, Taupō and Rotorua lake edges

kits.name: Gumland heath
kits.note: Stunted heath on old leached soils where kauri once stood; kauri gum dug from it.
kits.examples: Ahipara gumfield, Kaimaumau–Motutangi, Lake Ōhia, Spirits Bay

kits.name: Restiad peat bog
kits.note: Raised peat domes; the Hauraki and Waikato bogs were vast in 1810.

kits.name: Pakihi
kits.note: Wet infertile terraces with stunted mānuka.

kits.name: Giant golden dunes
kits.note: Huge mobile dunes, mostly bare sand.
kits.examples: Te Paki, Ninety Mile Beach, Onetahua

kits.name: Lava field and scoria
kits.note: Rangitoto was more bare lava in 1810. Pōhutukawa only in the north.
kits.examples: Rangitoto, Tāmaki cones, Tongariro lava flows

kits.name: Limestone karst
kits.note: Core-slice ground: the Ngāti Hine rohe around Waiōmio is karst country.
kits.examples: Waiōmio and Kawiti caves, Waitomo, Punakaiki, Takaka Hill

kits.name: Braided river
kits.note: Wide shingle beds, channels shift with floods.
kits.examples: Waimakariri, Rakaia, Tasman; Ngaruroro and Tukituki

kits.name: Alpine herbfield and scree
kits.note: Mt Cook lily and celmisia flower in early summer.
kits.examples: Tongariro Crossing, Ruapehu, Arthur's Pass, Aoraki

kits.name: Glaciers and permanent snow
kits.note: Glaciers reached lower in 1810 than today.
kits.examples: Fox, Kā Roimata o Hine Hukatere (Franz Josef), Tasman Glacier

kits.name: Montane moss forest
kits.note: Twisted, moss-hung kāmahi in cloud.

kits.name: Papa gorge country
kits.note: Deep river gorges cut in soft papa, forest to the water.

kits.name: Fiordland rainforest and fiords
kits.note: Sheer granite walls, waterfalls after rain.

kits.name: Central Otago schist and dry grassland
kits.note: Schist tors on dry tussock ranges.
kits.examples: Rock and Pillar, Old Man Range, Maniototo

kits.name: Coastal cliffs and turf
kits.note: Wind-shorn turf and flax on cliff tops.
kits.examples: Te Rerenga Wairua, Kaikōura coast, Wellington south coast
